_comment: Release INTENT only. Accepted product features are code (no switches). Infra identity lives in CDK / ios xcconfig and is cross-checked, not copied. Verified by scripts/release_config_gate.py (pre-deploy in CI + deploy workflows, post-deploy after cdk deploy). EMERGENCY ROLLBACK: set planner.emergency_override (e.g. "5.2") AND add a matching approved_overrides entry in the SAME reviewed PR; CDK then pins API and worker identically on every deploy until it is cleared. A time-boxed evaluation of ONE environment uses planner.environment_overrides.<env> instead (it never reaches another environment) with a matching approved_overrides entry that carries an expires date.

approved_overrides.reason: Editorial vNext: development-only device acceptance of the restored edit_plan/5.6 Highlights candidate (B2 is the visual reference). Time-boxed; beta, gamma and production stay on the default. ROLLBACK: set planner.environment_overrides.development back to "5.5" and this entry's value to "5.5" (or remove both for the 5.3 default) in one reviewed PR, then deploy-dev; no job migration is needed because the planner version is read per job.

Editorial vNext: beta pin to the edit_plan/5.6 Highlights planner after the owner's dev device acceptance. Time-boxed; gamma and production stay on the default. ROLLBACK: remove planner.environment_overrides.beta and this entry (beta returns to the 5.3 default) in one reviewed PR, then deploy beta with the observability context; no job migration is needed because the planner version is read per job.
